call.t: The Arctic Region: Security and critical protection
rs: The eligible countries are not stated in structured form by ESA Business Applications funding (business.esa.int). Check the call page.
call.x: The opportunity This is one of three sub-calls under the Arctic Region Call for Proposals, supporting European space-enabled solutions to address the region's growing operational, environmental and security challenges. Climate change, increasing maritime activity and the growing strategic importance of the Arctic are creating new security and resilience requirements. Critical infrastructure - including ports, energy assets, communication networks and transport corridors - is increasingly exposed to environmental hazards, operational disruptions and malicious activities. HE-GA-B.title: Horizon Europe Work Programme 2026-2027, General Annexes, B - Eligibility

consortium.quote: Unless otherwise provided for in the specific call/topic conditions, only legal entities forming a consortium are eligible to participate in actions provided that the consortium includes, as beneficiaries, three legal entities independent from each other and each established in a different country as follows: – at least one independent legal entity established in a Member State; and – at least two other independent legal entities, each established in different Member States or Associated Countries.
